breakdown.description: The simulation is for natural convection in a fluid layer heated from below (along Z-axis), but gravity is applied horizontally (in the -X direction), which will not drive the vertical buoyant instability.
breakdown.reason: The agent failed to correct the direction of the gravity vector. For Rayleigh-Bénard convection where the fluid is heated from below along the Z-axis, gravity must act downwards along the same axis. The ground truth correctly specifies this as `g (0 0 -9.81);`. The agent, however, repeated the incorrect instruction from the original prompt, defining gravity as `g (-9.81 0 0);` which points in the X-direction.
